# Postinstallation configuration for a disconnected {{ ibm_cloud_title }} cluster {#installing-ibm-cloud-restricted-postinstallation-configuration}

After you install a cluster on {{ ibm_cloud_name }} in a disconnected environment, you must complete the postinstallation configuration steps to prepare the cluster for use.
